control.description-key: PBS Hub Ops Console P-1 and P-2: payroll run list with approval progress, and the Jalankan payroll preflight (explicit period, pass/warn/block checklist).

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON {userEmail,userName,roles,permissions,config}. config: payrollLabelOffset (-1), payrollAssemblyMinutes (30), payrollPeriodOptions (6), payrollAnyPeriod (false), pageSize (50).

property.name: PayrollJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Payroll - PBS Hub]: ID, Title, PayrollName, Periode, Status, Trigger, TotalPayroll, TotalHost, the Approval and Comment columns, Created, Modified.

property.name: PayrollDataJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Payroll Data] for the runs above, only payroll_id and TotalGaji. Used for the total and host count per run.

property.name: PayslipJson
property.description-key: Optional. JSON rows of a payslip log (payroll_id, Status). v1 has no such list: leave blank.

property.name: HostsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Host - PBS Hub]: Title, NamaHost, Status, HasRekening. Never send KTP or NoRekening.

property.name: PreflightJson
property.description-key: JSON {period: yyyy-mm, clockIns: [Clock In rows of that month], reports: [Report rows with LiveDate in that month]} loaded after PREFLIGHT_PERIOD.

property.name: PreflightLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas loads PreflightJson: the checklist shows skeleton rows.

property.name: HasMore
property.description-key: true when canvas can load older runs: shows Muat lebih banyak and emits LOAD_MORE.

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading: renders skeleton rows.

property.name: ReferenceDate
property.description-key: Optional ISO date-time used as now (testing).

property.name: ActionPayload
property.description-key: JSON {action,requestId,payload}: OPEN_RUN, PREFLIGHT_PERIOD, RUN_PAYROLL, NAV, LOAD_MORE.
